english_description: Sourced from a “Primordial World (Self-Connecting Database)” archive within a 2026-07-29 batch upload. A member of the NT/nitan/Lonely engine family — related to nitan170911 (Chinese Paladin) and nitan6 (Laughing in the Wind) in this project — redesigned here around the world of Investiture of the Gods and the myth of Pangu separating heaven and earth.
